title: An honest average
description:
Write `double average(int total, int count)` that returns `total` divided by `count` **with decimals**.

```cpp
average(7, 2)    // 3.5, not 3
```

Both parameters are `int`, so a plain `total / count` throws the decimals away before the result is ever returned. Convert one of them first.
hints: `static_cast<double>(total) / count` converts `total` first; then the division is done with decimals.
